analyst.summary: Banco Products makes engine cooling systems and gaskets for the auto and industrial sectors, with a European subsidiary (NRF) giving it real export diversification, and has already extended its cooling expertise into battery and inverter coolers for electric vehicles. Growth has been steady in the high-teens-to-20s percent range with improving margins. We rate it a Hold: a well-run, sensibly diversified auto ancillary, fairly valued rather than a bargain.
